blocks.text: WASHINGTON — Jayson Tatum scored 28 of his 41 points in the first half and the Boston Celtics snapped their four-game losing streak by beating the Washington Wizards 131-116 on Tuesday night. The Celtics made 10 3-pointers during a 46-point second quarter. That gave Boston an 80-49 lead at halftime, and although Washington cut the deficit to five with a spirited second-half effort, the Celtics held on. The Celtics remained unbeaten in NBA Cup play, and Washington is mathematically eliminated.
